answer: Linear stake-time quotas assign work eligibility to locked token-seconds. Whether a job surveys a garden, a knoll or a glacier, the verifier consumes quota proportional to its reward and rejects reuse. Splitting one deposit across N accounts leaves its total token-seconds unchanged; N full quotas require N times the capital held for the same duration. The attacker bears the opportunity cost of locked funds. This requires linear accounting, no per-account reward floor and no double counting across jobs.
